arms.prompt: A woman's open palm held out flat, seen from the side in close view, with a single small ivory spiral seashell resting on it. The seashell is 7 cm long and fits easily within the cupped palm, smaller than her hand. Natural daylight, plain background.
arms.criterion: the shell is no more than 2x and no less than half the size it would really be against the hand (7 cm, smaller than the palm)

style.prompt: A woman's open palm held out flat, seen from the side in close view, with a single small ivory spiral seashell resting on it. The seashell is 7 cm long and fits easily within the cupped palm, smaller than her hand. Natural daylight, plain background.

result.observed: An open palm holds a single ivory spiral seashell that fits comfortably within the palm, well short of the fingers.

arms.prompt: Exactly three identical small wooden fishing boats moored side by side at a stone harbour wall, seen from the quay. Three boats, no more and no fewer. Overcast daylight.
arms.criterion: exactly three boats are present — not two, not four

style.prompt: Exactly three identical small wooden fishing boats moored side by side at a stone harbour wall, seen from the quay. Three boats, no more and no fewer. Overcast daylight.

result.observed: Three wooden fishing boats side by side below the harbour wall, plus a small yellow boat on the quay behind them.

arms.prompt: Change only the time of day to dusk, with warm low sunlight. Keep the person exactly as they are — same face, same hair, same clothing, same pose and same position in the frame. Keep the building, the landscape and every fixed object exactly where they are and the same shape. Change nothing but the light.
arms.criterion: the person is recognisably the same person, and the fixed parts of the place are unchanged in shape and position

style.prompt: Change only the time of day to dusk, with warm low sunlight. Keep the person exactly as they are — same face, same hair, same clothing, same pose and same position in the frame. Keep the building, the landscape and every fixed object exactly where they are and the same shape. Change nothing but the light.

result.observed: Overcast daylight changed to dark, warm dusk with an orange horizon, darker sky and rocks, and a brighter lighthouse lamp. The person's face, hair, clothing, pose and position remain the same, as do the lighthouse, buildings and rocky coastline.
